title: Heed E3: a Cullet town of minds, every body sampled
about: docs/ATTENTION_E3.md: the recording for E3's town states. Cullet's own seed and laws (48 m day sight); the mind service thinks for the first 40 adults of the first town by id, all 40 the trial's subject (LIVING_ONLY), nothing scripted or repurposed. Every creature's body, fighter row, activity and vitals are sampled 5 times a second (record.bodies all), with every experience and thought. Run on the fake model (`--fake`) for missed first blows, flicker, promotions and the size of the beyond-8 sample; a real-mind run of it is the proposal for the acted-on measure (not run).
gradient: None: a recording, not an experiment.
